items.headline: Youri Tielemans joins Manchester United from Aston Villa
items.summary: United activated Tielemans' release clause to sign the midfielder on a five-year contract. The Belgian player was acquired to strengthen the midfield.

items.headline: Rasmus Hojlund departs for Napoli on permanent deal
items.summary: Striker Rasmus Hojlund completed permanent transfer to Napoli. The deal closed during summer 2026 window.
